data.name: Alex Nguyen
data.story: Years of constant worry culminated in panic attacks at work. CBT sessions and daily breath-work exercises helped me regain control.

data.name: Priya Patel
data.story: I felt numb for months after a breakup. Journaling and a therapist-recommended exercise routine slowly lifted the fog.

data.name: Daniel O'Connor
data.story: Overtime and unrealistic deadlines burned me out. Setting clearer boundaries and using a Pomodoro schedule restored my energy.

data.name: Maria Lopez
data.story: Speaking in meetings terrified me. Gradual exposure—starting with one-on-one chats—plus mindful grounding cut my fear in half.

data.name: Jamal Carter
data.story: Night-long scrolling wrecked my sleep. A strict no-screens rule after 10 p.m. and melatonin got me back to 7-hour nights.

data.name: Emily Zhang
data.story: After my son was born I felt overwhelmed and detached. A support group and medication helped me reconnect with joy.

data.name: Kevin Brooks
data.story: My passion project turned into a 24/7 grind. Scheduling real weekends and delegating tasks brought back my creativity.

data.name: Sara Ali
data.story: A car accident left me hyper-vigilant. EMDR therapy and guided visualization reduced flashbacks substantially.
